theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁ with
  | refl => use a₂; exact ⟨.refl a₂, h₂⟩
  | red_I a =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, h₁⟩
    | par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc] at h₁
      use a₁'; exact ⟨ha, .red_I a₁'⟩
    | red_I => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, h₁⟩
  | red_K a b =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, h₁⟩
    | par a' c' ha hc =>
      let ⟨a₁', h'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      rw [h'.2] at h₁
      use a₁'; exact ⟨h'.1, .red_K a₁' c'⟩
    | red_K => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, h₁⟩
  | red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, h₁⟩
    | par d c' hd hc =>
      let ⟨a', b', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [h.2.2]
      use a' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b' ⬝ c')
      constructor
      · apply ParallelReduction.par
        · exact .par h.left hc
        · exact .par h.2.1 hc
      · exact .red_S ..
    | red_S => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, h₁⟩
  | par a a' b b' ha hb =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => use a' ⬝ b'; exact ⟨.refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | par a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
      let ⟨a₃, ha₃⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
      let ⟨b₃, hb₃⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
      use a₃ ⬝ b₃
      exact ⟨.par ha₃.1 hb₃.1, .par ha₃.2 hb₃.2⟩
